feature: Linear Clone - A sleek project management app with issues, status workflow, and modern UI

tests.description: App loads with a clean, modern UI similar to Linear's dark theme aesthetic
Can create a new issue with title and description
Issues display in a Kanban board with columns: Backlog, Todo, In Progress, Done
Can drag and drop issues between status columns
Can set issue priority (Urgent, High, Medium, Low, No Priority)
Issues show priority indicator with appropriate color coding
Can click on an issue to view/edit its details in a side panel
Issues persist in localStorage so they survive page refresh
Keyboard shortcut 'C' opens new issue form
